# /crav1-ask-open-questions

[All skills](../skills.md) · Walkthrough: [Ask open questions](../../from-ask-open-questions.md) · Playbook: [`SKILL.md`](../../../.cursor/skills/crav1/crav1-ask-open-questions/SKILL.md)

## Purpose

Gather the open questions in the specs for one person, one spec, or one topic, and draft them as a mail, a meeting agenda, a chat message, or meeting questions to ask out loud.

Drafts the open questions for a person, a spec, or a topic as a mail, a meeting agenda, a chat message, or meeting questions. No spec names in the draft. Nothing is sent. Yes, no, or pending records whether they were asked.

## Runs when

Someone else has to answer open questions. Called by the user.

## Reads

In short: Open questions on the specs for a person, a spec, or a topic.

Reads `## Open questions`, unresolved assumptions, and their `Asked:`, `Pending:`, and `Answered:` lines on every `docs/specs/<slug>/spec.md`, skipping `_template`, for the person, spec, or topic the user named.

## Writes

In short: A draft in chat; `Asked:` or `Pending:` lines under those questions after yes or pending; the transfer data policy after a yes.

Writes a draft in the chat only (mail, meeting agenda, chat message, or meeting questions), numbered and grouped by topic in plain words, in English or the language named, with no spec slug, path, or question id. After yes or pending, writes only `Asked:` or `Pending:` lines under those questions, following `crav1-add-to-spec` `references/open-questions.md`. The personal-data and secrets check in `crav1-add-to-spec` `references/sources.md` runs on the draft and may write the transfer data policy after a yes.

## Does not

Leaves the question text, every other spec line, `docs/system/`, plan, tasks, and code alone. Sends nothing. Does not commit.

Limits and exceptions: no person, spec, or topic stops and asks. Pending questions are shown first: mark as sent, keep pending, or drop the mark. No writes nothing. Meeting questions lists every selected question. It names [`/crav1-meeting-to-specs`](crav1-meeting-to-specs.md) or [`/crav1-match-dump-to-specs`](crav1-match-dump-to-specs.md) for the answers and [`/crav1-finalize-commit`](crav1-finalize-commit.md) when a mark was written, and does not run them. It is not a starter option.

## You run next / Runs by itself

- You run next: [`/crav1-meeting-to-specs`](crav1-meeting-to-specs.md); [`/crav1-match-dump-to-specs`](crav1-match-dump-to-specs.md); [`/crav1-finalize-commit`](crav1-finalize-commit.md)
- Runs by itself: Calls no skill.

## Lane and group

Lane: Cross-cutting. Group: Meetings and open questions. Starter option: no. Routing: [guild routing](../../guild-routing.md).

## Stage and since

Stage: stable. Since: 1.40.0 ([changelog](../../../CHANGELOG.md)).
